status: A development plan; separate from teammate-owned final-test protocol
question: Does native-resolution JPEG format matching help the local branch, and do quality cues improve fusion of the matched experts?
calibration: raw only, matching Round 7 W1; calibration partition unused
expert_fit: Same Round 7 assignments; one clean view per original; refit both global and local heads in both arms in this runtime
matched_views: Apply unchanged W1 native-size Q60-95 matching before geometry, degradation and PatchShuffle to expert_fit, gate_fit and selection tuning only
unmatched_views: Original decoded images followed by inherited geometry and degradation
gate_fit: Disjoint gate_fit originals; clean/jpeg70/resize05 equally weighted; matched views in matched arm; unchanged paired gate_models.py implementation
selection: Select gate epoch, fixed alpha and thresholds only on selection tuning clean/jpeg70/resize05; matched views in matched arm
reporting: Original (never format-matched) selection and ADM/BigGAN development images; clean/jpeg70/jpeg50/resize05; JPEG50 never used for tuning
ablation: score_gate and quality_gate use identical experts, architecture, non-quality inputs and paired initializations; score_gate zeros the final three standardized quality features
aggregation: Per generator and condition. Average gate metrics within each data seed, then mean and sample SD over the three data seeds. Differences paired within data seed. No pooled gate predictions, no treating nine gates as nine data seeds.
decision: Report all specified comparisons, including clean-image costs; no post-hoc pass threshold, architecture search or model selection using development scores
test_policy: No Round 7 reserved-test manifest, images or predictions. Fresh Round 8 test construction, final protocol, freeze and evaluation belong to the protocol owner and are not implemented here.
runtime: Pin actual environment and source/input/model hashes before feature extraction; reject drift on resume. Recomputed controls are not claimed to be byte-identical to Round 7.
limitations: Three splits share the fitting pool and development originals
Real images retain prior JPEG history
Matching gate-fit/tuning is an explicit extension of W1, which did not train gates
